title: account.deactivated v1 payload
description: The owner deactivated their own account from Settings (plan 08 3C), re-authenticated with the password, or asked to delete it (the same state during the 30-day grace that ends in account.deleted). Every session and refresh token was revoked in the same transaction. Signing in again reactivates it (account.reactivated). subject_id and actor_id are the account. Profile, post and search hide what the account owns until account.reactivated.
